title: Centripetal Structure under Alienation-Based Abstention
abstract: arXiv:2608.03788v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Alienation-based abstention makes participation endogenous because the platforms chosen by parties determine who votes. We study how voter tolerance affects the existence, location, and persistence of pure-strategy equilibria in two versions of a two-party spatial model. In the first, office-seeking parties maximize voter plurality; in the second, they care about the policy implemented. We characterize all office-seeking equilibria through a condition called window dominance, which gives a distributional characterisation of profitable deviations both near to and far from a party's platform. For general continuous voter distributions, pure strategy equilibrium in the office seeking game may fail to exist, may be non-unique, and may appear and disappear as tolerance increases. To resolve this, we identify a centripetal structure in the set of positions that can not lose to each rival. When this structure holds, a single anchor defeats

translated_title: 基于疏离感弃权下的向心结构
translated_abstract: 基于疏离感的弃权使投票参与成为内生的，因为政党所选择的竞选纲领决定了谁会去投票。我们在两党空间模型的两个版本中研究选民容忍度如何影响纯策略均衡的存在性、位置与持久性。在第一个版本中，追逐职位的政党以最大化得票数为目标；在第二个版本中，政党关心最终实施的政策。我们通过一个称为“窗口优势”（window dominance）的条件刻画了所有追逐职位的均衡，该条件从选民分布的角度描述了在政党纲领附近及远处何种偏离是有利可图的。对于一般的连续选民分布，追逐职位博弈中的纯策略均衡可能不存在、可能不唯一，并且可能随容忍度的提高而出现或消失。为解决这一问题，我们在所有不会败给对手的位置集合中识别出一种向心结构。当该结构成立时，单一的“锚点”位置能够击败……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在基于疏离感弃权的两党空间竞争模型中，通过“窗口优势”条件刻画了均衡的存在性与不确定性，并识别出一种“向心结构”，当该结构成立时可保证存在一个能击败所有对手位置的唯一锚点均衡。
